steam-not-found.title: Steam installation not found
steam-not-found.summary: Vortex cannot locate this game's Steam installation.
steam-not-found.details: Make sure Steam is installed and has been started at least once. Vortex supports native, Flatpak and Snap Steam installations, including custom XDG data directories.

app-id-not-found.title: Steam App ID not found
app-id-not-found.summary: Vortex cannot associate this game with its Steam library entry.
app-id-not-found.details: Rescan your games. If the problem remains, the game extension needs a Steam App ID in its store metadata.

prefix-not-found.title: Proton prefix not initialized
prefix-not-found.summary: Steam has not created the Windows environment used by this game.
prefix-not-found.details: Start the game once from Steam, wait until it reaches the main menu, then close it and refresh Health Check.

runtime-not-found.title: Proton runtime not found
runtime-not-found.summary: Vortex cannot find an installed Proton runtime for this game.
runtime-not-found.details: Open the game's Steam Properties, enable a compatibility tool, install or select Proton, then refresh Health Check.

read-only.title: Read-only filesystem
read-only.details: The path {{path}} is on the read-only mount {{mountPoint}}.
read-only.remediation: Mount the filesystem with write access or move the game and staging directories to a writable location.

noexec.title: Execution is disabled on this filesystem
noexec.details: The mount {{mountPoint}} uses the noexec option, which prevents the game or Proton from running.
noexec.remediation: Remove the noexec option for this mount or move the affected files to an executable filesystem.

ntfs-prefix.title: Proton prefix is on a non-POSIX filesystem
ntfs-prefix.summary: The Proton prefix uses {{fsType}}, which may not support required Linux semantics.
ntfs-prefix.details: Wine prefixes require reliable permissions and symbolic links; {{path}} is on {{fsType}}.
ntfs-prefix.remediation: Move the Proton prefix or Steam library to a native Linux filesystem such as ext4 or btrfs.

cross-device-hardlink.title: Hardlink deployment crosses filesystems
cross-device-hardlink.summary: The staging and deployment directories cannot use hardlinks.
cross-device-hardlink.details: Hardlinks cannot be created between {{path}} and a destination on another filesystem.
cross-device-hardlink.remediation: Move the staging directory to the game's filesystem or select a supported symlink deployment method.

insufficient-disk-space.title: Not enough free disk space
insufficient-disk-space.summary: The deployment destination does not have enough free space.
insufficient-disk-space.details: Deploying to {{path}} requires {{required}} plus a {{reserve}} safety reserve, but only {{available}} is available.
insufficient-disk-space.remediation: Free disk space, move the game to a larger filesystem, or select a link-based deployment method.

permission-denied.title: Directory is not writable
permission-denied.summary: Vortex does not have write access to {{path}}.
permission-denied.details: The current user cannot write to {{path}}.
permission-denied.remediation: Correct the directory ownership or user permissions without granting broader access than necessary.

flatpak-permission-missing.title: Flatpak filesystem permission is missing
flatpak-permission-missing.details: The relevant Flatpak application needs access to {{path}}.
flatpak-permission-missing.remediation: Grant access only to the affected directory with Flatseal or the scoped flatpak override command shown in the diagnostics.

symlink-unavailable.title: Symbolic links are unavailable
symlink-unavailable.summary: Vortex cannot create symbolic links in {{path}}.
symlink-unavailable.details: The deployment destination does not support the symbolic links required by the selected method.
symlink-unavailable.remediation: Choose another writable Linux filesystem or select a compatible deployment method.
